A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Your questions.
Answered.

Is tutoring one-to-one?＋

Yes. Our service focuses on individual live online lessons shaped around the student’s school course and learning needs.

What do I need for an online lesson?＋

A laptop, desktop, or tablet; a reliable internet connection; a working microphone; and your school materials. The lesson link is arranged before you start.

Can you help with schoolwork and exams?＋

Yes. We can work on concepts, practice questions, revision, and exam technique. Tutors guide the learning; students complete their own assessed work.

How much do lessons cost?＋

Pricing pages show illustrative sample lesson rates and totals. Actual rates depend on subject, level, curriculum, frequency, and availability. Confirm your quote before starting; no payment is taken here.

Can I choose a time in my country?＋

Share your time zone and preferred windows. A request expresses a preference; the session is confirmed only after a time and tutor are agreed.

How does the free demo work?＋

Prepare an introductory demo enquiry with your subject and goals. The demo is an opportunity to discuss your needs and explore the lesson approach. Availability must be confirmed.
